DSH Fleet is a ticket-driven multi-agent harness whose dynamic swarms are guided by harness-engineering research, in active development; DeepSeek Harness is an open-source project by the deepseek-ai organization (deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, MIT), and DSH Fleet is not affiliated with DeepSeek.
intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder building advanced agent infrastructure with Claude Code. Three systems: Ergon, whose employee agents configure themselves by learning a role; the DSH Fleet, a distributed, recursively self-improving orchestration layer for dynamic agent swarms; and OpenBell, built around directly constructing and rigorously evaluating tiny models in weight space. Across all three: autonomy with evidence — persistent memory, earned permissions, frozen hypotheses, measured promotion gates, and human approval only where an action warrants it.
